description: The patch kept the unused teacher on the CPU while preserving the recorded parameter count.

notes: Teacher model (~1.8 GB params) is resident on GPU but never used (distillation_weight=0.0). Moving to CPU saves well above required 0.62 GB.
Device placement change does not require allow_model_change=true; it preserves all model architecture, parameters, and mathematics.
Optimizer state (23 MB) and activations (33 MB) are smaller contributors; AdamW temporaries (53 MB peak) are short-lived workspace allocations.
No batch size or gradient accumulation changes needed; the dominant avoidable peak component is the unused teacher model.

root_causes.title: Two resident models (student + teacher) dominate peak memory
AdamW optimizer state for student model
Forward activation working set for student model
AdamW backward workspace temporaries (div, sqrt, mm)
